libs=[ctypes.CDLL(str(p)) for p in paths]
for lib in libs:
 for layout in ('contiguous','masked'):
  fn=getattr(lib,'moe_int8_'+layout);fn.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p]*6+[ctypes.c_int]*4+[ctypes.c_void_p];fn.restype=ctypes.c_int
report=dict(scope='full CPU references and bitwise baseline comparison for aligned and deliberately unaligned INT8 input addresses',source_sha256=hashlib.sha256((r/'02_optimized_gemm/optimized_gemm.cpp').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),library_sha256=hashlib.sha256(paths[1].read_bytes()).hexdigest(),baseline_library_sha256=hashlib.sha256(paths[0].read_bytes()).hexdigest(),checks=[])
counts=[1,0,3,17];g=4;n=19;k=64;cap=19
for layout in ('contiguous','masked'):
 for ao,bo in ((0,0),(1,0),(0,1),(1,1),(2,3),(3,2)):
  stream=torch.cuda.Stream()
  with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
   torch.manual_seed(20261020+ao*10+bo)
   rows=cap if layout=='masked' else sum(counts);physical=g*rows if layout=='masked' else rows
   ast=torch.randint(-128,128,(physical*k+ao,),device='cuda',dtype=torch.int8)
   bst=torch.randint(-128,128,(g*n*k+bo,),device='cuda',dtype=torch.int8)
   a=ast[ao:].view(physical,k);b=bst[bo:].view(g,n,k)
   assert a.data_ptr()%4==ao and b.data_ptr()%4==bo
   sa=torch.rand(physical,device='cuda')*.03+.005;sb=torch.rand(g,n,device='cuda')*.03+.005
   offsets=np.cumsum([0]+counts,dtype=np.int32)
   meta=torch.tensor(counts if layout=='masked' else offsets.tolist(),dtype=torch.int32,device='cuda')
   outs=[torch.full((physical,n),-123456.75,device='cuda') for _ in libs]
   for e,m in enumerate(counts):
    start=e*cap if layout=='masked' else int(offsets[e])
    for out in outs:out[start:start+m].fill_(float('nan'))
   for lib,out in zip(libs,outs):
    rc=getattr(lib,'moe_int8_'+layout)(*(v.data_ptr() for v in (a,b,sa,sb,meta,out)),g,rows,n,k,stream.cuda_stream)
    assert rc==0,rc
  stream.synchronize()
  aa=a.cpu().numpy().astype(np.int64);bb=b.cpu().numpy().astype(np.int64)

  assert np.array_equal(vals[0].view(np.uint32),vals[1].view(np.uint32))
  checked=padding=0;max_abs=0.
  for e,m in enumerate(counts):
   start=e*cap if layout=='masked' else int(offsets[e])
   expected=(aa[start:start+m]@bb[e].T).astype(np.float64)*sa_cpu[start:start+m,None]*sb_cpu[e,None,:]
   got=vals[1][start:start+m].astype(np.float64)
   assert np.isfinite(got).all() and np.all(np.abs(got-expected)<=1e-6+1e-5*np.abs(expected))
   if m:max_abs=max(max_abs,float(np.max(np.abs(got-expected))))
   checked+=m*n
   if layout=='masked':
    assert (vals[1][start+m:start+cap]==-123456.75).all();padding+=(cap-m)*n
  report['checks'].append(dict(layout=layout,a_offset=ao,b_offset=bo,packed_path=ao==bo==0,checked_elements=checked,padding_checked=padding,max_abs_error=max_abs,status='PASS'))
  print(layout,ao,bo,'PASS',flush=True)
report['status']='PASS'
